2014_spells.arcane-sword.description: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to move the sword up to 20 feet to a spot you can see and repeat this attack against the same target or a different one.
2014_spells.arcane-sword.effectSummary: Deal 3d10 force damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.arcane-sword.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 force damage; When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target of your choice within 5 feet of the sword. It lasts for the duration; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
